C1493.title: Pikachu: Securing PoS Blockchains from Long-Range Attacks by Checkpointing into Bitcoin PoW using Taproot
C1493.summary: The 2022 Pikachu study examines long-range attacks on Proof-of-Stake blockchains, in which an adversary who obtains old validator keys can cheaply build an alternative chain from historical blocks. It proposes using Taproot to embed PoS checkpoints in Bitcoin's Proof-of-Work chain, allowing nodes to verify history against immutable Bitcoin records and limiting an attacker's ability to rewrite the full PoS ledger.
